en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a large, ornate villa called 'Villa Bergfried' set on a hillside surrounded by dense forest and a meadow in the foreground. The multi‑storey building has steep roofs, gables, balconies and decorative wooden elements, with a few people visible walking or standing near the fence and in the meadow. Printed German text in red appears at the top describing the villa and its location in the Ore Mountains.
